special_notes: Each of the four caster wheels has two independent, continuous axes of rotation: a roll axis (horizontal) for forward/backward movement and a swivel axis (vertical) for steering. The [pivot] tag in the USD indicates the swivel point.
grip_location: The horizontal bars or top tray surface are used for pushing.
